teaser: HBR's deployment gap, answered from this site's articles: explorers, villagers and town planners, a record the agents keep, and open source.
core_idea: The gap between a vibe-coded prototype and a tool people rely on is the handover from explorers to villagers and town planners; the prototype is the best brief, not the mess; agents that keep a mandate, a memory and a graph make the architecture knowable; the bonus test is the town planner's accountability; and open source means more than one party can fix it.
